applicationAssemblies.selection: Explicit proposed non-note component with data.approvalProfile matching node.id and provider; fits durable human-reviewed typed workflows on PostgreSQL. Do not apply this as a universal business application recipe.
applicationAssemblies.accountId: Canonical logical application-account UUID; not a cloud account ID
applicationAssemblies.payloadContract: Exactly version=1,id (lowercase identifier),source,result; source/result are closed object schemas with type/properties/required. Fields support bounded string(minBytes,maxBytes), integer(minimum,maximum), boolean, enum(values), array(items,maxItems) and nested object. No JSON Schema extensions/coercion.
applicationAssemblies.destinationContract: Reviewed id,endpointSha256,scope,mappingVersion; never a credential or invented vendor mapping.
applicationAssemblies.emitted: Shared API source, profile, exact provider lock, Dockerfile and explicit missing-work/task record
applicationAssemblies.boundary: Source assembly only. Resources, domain processor/worker, identity/database/environment wiring and full tests remain required; never clear work gates or claim application completion. Retain an absent profile while real choices are unresolved; do not invent provider/client identifiers or acceptance.
applicationAssemblies.projectFileVersion: 3.0.0 only for approval-workflow projects, so older readers reject instead of dropping this intent

deferredBinding.boundary: Public values only. No cloud lookup or source attestation; unresolved, partial or mismatched bundles cannot start. Fixed ownership, operation and policy cannot be deferred.
